image_description: A street scene featuring a woman in colorful attire (pink hat, striped skirt) blowing large soap bubbles. The primary subject is a large, translucent bubble in the foreground exhibiting strong iridescence and background distortion. A second, smaller bubble is visible near her mouth. The background consists of a European-style stone building and pedestrians on a paved street. There is a watermark '© HZ' in the top left corner.
